name: Keyword counter — no false dependency with other ability effects
notes: Memory: project_keyword_counter_false_dependency_fix_2026-04-24. KEYWORD_COUNTER was missing from the static-additive list, so ability counters reported spurious dependencies against other effects. Here Grizzly Bears has a flying counter and is equipped with Lizard Blades (double strike); both abilities must be present and layer 6 stays in timestamp order.
